claims.why: Code checks for duplicate relation names in relation_weights and raises ValueError.

claims.text: token cost for node_id must be positive

observations.what: Diffusion loop accumulates scores using decay factor and breaks if frontier empty.
DSSConfig validates multiple fields but does not validate that relation_weights sum to 1 or similar; only checks non-negative and finite.
ContextItem and ContextPlan are simple frozen dataclasses with to_dict methods; no validation of estimated_tokens or reasons.
_estimated_tokens uses generator expression next(node for node in forest.nodes if node.id == node_id) which raises StopIteration if no match, instead of a clearer error.
_estimated_tokens is incomplete; only shown up to for key in ... line, missing the actual lookup logic.
